correctness.rationale: Exact integer bracket expansion proves the Jacobi criterion. For n>=13, J(0,1,2) has eight distinct basis labels with nonzero +/-1 coefficients in every characteristic. For 1<=n<=12, the bundled standalone checker exhausts all n^3 ordered triples, using no approximations, and returns coefficient gcds 0,0,0,2,1,1,1,1,3,1,1,1. The exceptional derived rank six is established from differences among the three mod-three classes.
